items.source:
The map function to use (default is empty, which will trigger a default map function filtering on the repository's
associated entity type).
items.translation: 要使用的 map 函数（默认为空，这将触发针对存储库关联实体类型的默认 map 函数）。

items.source: The reduce function to use (default is built in "_count" reduce function).
items.translation: 要使用的 reduce 函数（默认是内置的"_count"reduce 函数）。

items.source: The name of the view, defaults to "all" (which is what CRUD methods expect by default).
items.translation: 视图的名称，默认为"all"（这正是 CRUD 方法默认期望的值）。

items.source:
The view must at least be described as a design document name and view name. Default map function will filter
documents on the type associated to the repository, and default reduce function is "_count".
items.translation: 视图必须至少被描述为设计文档名称和视图名称。默认的映射函数将过滤与存储库关联类型的文档，而默认的归约函数为"_count"。

items.source: One can specify a custom reduce function as well as a non-default map function.
items.translation: 还可以指定自定义的 reduce 函数以及非默认的 map 函数。

items.source: The design document in which to create/look for the view.
items.translation: 用于创建或查找视图的设计文档。

items.source:
The design document in which to create/look for the view. Usually to create the backing view for CRUD methods, the
expected designDoc value is the entity's simple class name, with a lowercase first letter (eg. a UserInfo
repository would expect a design document named "userInfo").
items.translation: 用于创建或查找视图的设计文档。通常，要为 CRUD 方法创建后备视图，预期的 designDoc 值应为实体的简单类名，首字母小写（例如，UserInfo 仓库会期望一个名为"userInfo"的设计文档）。

items.source: This annotation is targeted at Repository interfaces, indicating that the framework should ensure a View is present when the repository is instantiated.
items.translation: 此注解针对Repository接口，指示框架在实例化存储库时应确保存在视图。
